_comment: Per-term OG-card focus modules, merged into the glossary cards by scripts/seed-glossary-og.mjs. A focus added straight to brand/og/cards.json would be stripped on the next re-seed (the generator rewrites every glossary-* entry), so curated focuses live here. Keyed by glossary slug; value is { en: {focus}, es: {focus} }. type keys into focusModules in scripts/build-og-cards.mjs (stat | bars | list | quote | checks | funnel | score-ring). Every number MUST already appear on the term's own /glossary/<slug>/ page — the fact gate applies to cards too.
